faq.headline: What you need to know before your surgical decision.

faq-1.question: How does the private care flow work?
faq-1.answer: Care at Hospital São Rafael follows an integrated flow from first contact to discharge. It all starts with scheduling through our service center, which organizes each stage according to your needs: appointments, exams, check-ups, and surgical preparation. Next, you have appointments and exams at IMD, the Medical and Diagnostic Institute, where all information is already entered digitally into the integrated medical record. With preparation completed, including the pre-anesthetic consultation when indicated, the procedure is performed in one of our 22 surgical centers. After surgery, you go through recovery with continuous team support and can rely on the Transition Unit until your safe return to routine. This entire journey happens without leaving our complex.

faq-2.question: Can my surgeon operate at São Rafael?
faq-2.answer: Yes. Hospital São Rafael is an open medical staff hospital, which means any physician with active registration and good standing with the medical board can request credentialing to perform procedures in our facilities, without needing an employment relationship with the hospital. The process is conducted by our Institutional Medical Consulting team, which evaluates the professional's profile and aligns applicable specialties and protocols. Once credentialed, the surgeon has access to 22 surgical rooms equipped with state-of-the-art technology, specialized surgical technicians, dedicated technical support, and 40-minute room turnover, ensuring predictability and efficiency for their schedule. To begin the process, get in touch via the "Talk to Institutional Medical Consulting" button.

faq-3.question: What is the real difference of the Accommodation Upgrade?
faq-3.answer: The Accommodation Upgrade turns the post-surgical period into a differentiated recovery experience. In addition to full clinical support, you get a room with greater privacy and comfort, exclusive and personalized service, and an environment designed for you to rest peacefully. It is the ideal choice for those who want a hospital stay with elevated hospitality standards, combining medical excellence and well-being in every detail.

faq-4.question: How does IMD speed up my surgery?
faq-4.answer: IMD operates fully integrated with Hospital São Rafael's surgical block. Appointments, imaging exams, and reports performed at the Institute automatically feed the surgical center's digital medical record — without referrals, information repetition, or data loss. When surgery day comes, your physician already has access to everything they need, with full traceability. This model eliminates the wait and bureaucracy that usually exists between diagnosis and procedure, ensuring more agility, safety, and predictability for you and your surgeon.
